cards.title: The Secret Behind Bedtime Stalling
cards.body: Bedtime stalling isn't simple opposition—it's a child's request for connection at their most vulnerable time. Small changes to your routine can transform bedtime from a battle into a calmer experience for everyone.

cards.title: Is Blame Culture Brainwashing Your Adult Child?
cards.body: Influencers can convince your adult child that you're 'toxic' without context or nuance. Understanding this dynamic helps parents navigate complicated adult relationships with their children.

cards.title: 5 Myths That Keep Emotional Neglect Hidden
cards.body: Emotional neglect is one of the most misunderstood childhood experiences, even among professionals. Understanding the truth about it can open pathways to healing for both children and adults.

cards.title: Chronic Illness Is the New Rite of Passage in Motherhood
cards.body: More mothers are navigating chronic illness alongside parenting responsibilities. Challenging the narrative that women are responsible for becoming sick is crucial for maternal well-being.

cards.title: Parents: Tell Us How You're Balancing Work and Childcare
cards.body: The summer holidays bring annual challenges as parents juggle work with childcare responsibilities. Rising costs and logistics make this season particularly stressful for many families.

cards.title: At a Dying Man's Bedside: Teaching Youth About Death
cards.body: Shielding young people from the reality of death postpones their struggle to reconcile with it until middle age. Including children in these universal human experiences builds emotional resilience.

cards.title: Patrice Lawrence Named Children's Laureate
cards.body: Author of bestselling young-adult novel Orangeboy is ideally positioned to address the crisis of teenage masculinity and reading. His appointment signals focus on engaging young readers facing modern challenges.
